biography: I want to join the Global South AI Policy Coalition to contribute a practitioner’s perspective to the evolving conversation around responsible AI governance. My work in AI, GenAI, data, and knowledge systems gives me a strong interest in how emerging technologies can be developed and deployed responsibly. I am particularly interested in AI accountability, data governance, and the governance challenges created by agentic AI. The Coalition’s focus on cross-regional collaboration and evidence-based policy strongly aligns with my interests. I would also value the opportunity to learn from and collaborate with researchers, policymakers, and technology practitioners across the Global South.
